google/veo-3.1-lite.review_note: This is one controlled, policy-compliant prompt experiment after repeated terminal provider no-output receipts. Author the positive_prompt exactly as supplied below. Keep it camera-only and do not name or describe any visible subject, body part, device, activity, relationship, health topic, or brand.

topology_anchors: The positive_prompt must be exactly: "The camera moves slowly straight forward, centered and steady throughout the shot."
contacts: Do not introduce or change source contacts.

image_reading: One smiling woman sits cross-legged on a sofa, looking down at an orange smartphone held in her left hand.
Her right index finger is poised close to the visible phone screen, but the exact touch state and intended interface action are ambiguous.
The woman and phone are the central foreground subjects; the sofa, cushions, wall frames, books, and fireplace form rigid surrounding regions.
The image does not expose readable screen content, and no additional people or active environmental motion are visible.
analysis.article_context: Body image supporting the advice to prepare questions before a medical consultation, emphasizing calm, organized preparation so important concerns are not overlooked.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Calm, organized preparation helps a person collect questions before a medical consultation and avoid overlooking important concerns.
structured_intent.initial_state: One smiling woman is seated cross-legged on a sofa, holding an orange smartphone and looking down at it, with her other index finger poised near the screen.
structured_intent.primary_action: A bounded straight push-in toward the current framing.
structured_intent.attention_anchor: The woman holding the orange smartphone.
structured_intent.motion_boundary: Only the camera may move; the woman, hands, phone, clothing, sofa, cushions, frames, books, fireplace, and all other source-defined regions remain locked in state and topology, with no new screen content or objects.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The same centered composition is viewed slightly closer, with the woman and smartphone still fully recognizable and all original semantic regions retained.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: The phone remains supported by the visible hand; the seated pose, sofa contact, and rigid room geometry remain unchanged.
structured_intent.identity_invariant: Exactly one woman, one orange smartphone, two visible hands with unchanged fingers and limbs, and the same furniture and background objects.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The woman remains calm, attentive, and engaged in organized preparation through the final frame.
structured_intent.feasibility_assessment: The image clearly establishes one seated woman holding a smartphone and looking toward it, but the fingertip-to-screen contact and any specific interface action are ambiguous. A bounded camera-only push-in is safer than inventing tapping, typing, or screen changes.

models.scene_plan: Over four seconds, execute one centered, steady push-in at a calm, even speed, slowing gently near the end. Keep the original framing continuously retained and the woman with her phone centered; finish after no more than about 5% screen-space travel, without exposing space beyond the source frame or animating the subject, phone, furniture, or background independently.
models.positive_prompt: The camera moves slowly straight forward, centered and steady throughout the shot.
